title: BiLSTM Toxicity Classifier with Identity Swaps
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments into up to 256 word/punctuation tokens, building a training-only vocabulary from tokens occurring at least twice, with padding and unknown IDs. A two-layer bidirectional LSTM embeds tokens, applies word-vector dropout, and combines masked max and mean pooling. A residual dense head produces a toxicity logit and auxiliary logits for identity labels. Training uses soft toxicity targets, identity-aware sample weights, auxiliary multilabel BCE, Adam, fp16 autocasting with gradient scaling, gradient clipping, and exponential learning-rate decay. Length-bucketed shuffled batches reduce padding. Eligible rows with exactly one confirmed identity mention are augmented by replacing that identity’s tokens with terms from another identity; swapped examples retain toxicity targets, receive moved auxiliary labels, and are constrained to have similar toxicity logits. Validation runs length-sorted batched sigmoid inference and evaluates probabilities.
